title: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Discover Ratsputin's Gulag

Quest Reward: 18750 Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go forth, Dungeon Runner, to Ratsputin's Gulag! Then, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

There is a dungeon ahead that is a great mystery to us, Dungeon Runner. Ratsputin's Gulag is a puzzling place indeed, but it is where the road has taken you. You should know that the battles ahead are not like what you have seen before. Death waits for you there! Probably more death than you are typically used to, anyway....

Ratsputin rules his dungeon with an iron grasp, controlling his minions with realllly scary visions. Before you go off and start putting your axe to the grindstone, there is something I need to tell you. Something about Ratsputin. This is not the first time we have sent a Dungeon Runner to 'take care' of Ratsputin. In fact, you are the... let me see... carry the seventy eight... ah, yes! You are the seventy ninth! Don't worry about them though, they are all taking a nice long vacation to the center of the HDoL.

Your first quest is to just get in there and check the place out. All the serious mumbo-jumbo aside, it is not such a bad place. Check out Ratsputin's Holding Cell and then enter into Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Once you have done this, return to me, the Townston Commander of Townston. Townston. I cannot stop saying Townston. I just... I just love this place. Townston!

Turn-in:

What did you think? It is not like any other dungeon, is it? My sarcasm detector is going crazy. Well, what do you want!? Townston's Department of Dungeon Runners for the Building of Sweet Dungeons operates on a show-string budget, you know!

Objectives:

  • Ratsputin's Holding Cell
  • Ratsputin's Gulag Level 1

Client level range: 75–100
